# Ilona Ayelén Pajor

> Personal website of Ilona Ayelén Pajor, political scientist from Argentina, specialist in public policies and gender justice and in university teaching. Adjunct professor at UCES and researcher at UNTREF (FemTech; technology, gender and cognitive capitalism) and UNNE.

- [CV in English (Markdown)](https://ilonapajor.github.io/cv-en.md): full academic and professional record in English
